source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 10 (PDF 276-287), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 10 (Solution of Trigonometric Equations) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Solve \(2\cos^{2}x + 3\sin x = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(2\cos^{2}x + 3\sin x = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos^{2}x\) ko \(1 - \sin^{2}x\) mein badlein, \(\sin x\) mein quadratic hal karein aur \([-1, 1]\) se bahar wali value chhor dein.

book_ref.quote: Reduce the equation to one or more basic equations

steps: \(\sin x = -\frac{1}{2}\): reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); sine negative, is liye III aur IV

blocks.prompt:
2 Solve \(4\sin^{2}x - 8\cos x + 1 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(4\sin^{2}x - 8\cos x + 1 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin^{2}x = 1 - \cos^{2}x\) likh kar \(\cos x\) mein quadratic banayein.

book_ref.quote: Find the reference angle \(\alpha\) from the positive value

steps: \(\cos x = \frac{1}{2}\): reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\); cosine positive, is liye I aur IV

blocks.prompt:
3 Solve \(\sec^{2}x + (1 - \sqrt{3})\tan x - (1 + \sqrt{3}) = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(\sec^{2}x + (1 - \sqrt{3})\tan x - (1 + \sqrt{3}) = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sec^{2}x = 1 + \tan^{2}x\) se \(\tan x\) mein quadratic banayein; \(\tan\) ka period \(\pi\) hai.

book_ref.quote: Period \(2\pi\) for \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\csc\); period \(\pi\) for \(\tan\), \(\cot\)

steps: In values par \(\cos x \ne 0\), is liye \(\sec x\) aur \(\tan x\) defined hain
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \(\frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{4\pi}{3}, \frac{7\pi}{4}\); general solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.prompt:
4 Solve \(\tan x + \sec x = \sqrt{3}\). (5 marks)
(\(\tan x + \sec x = \sqrt{3}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sine aur cosine mein badlein, square kar ke aik ratio banayein, phir har root asal equation mein check karein.

book_ref.quote: Squaring can bring in extraneous roots

steps: \(\frac{\sin x}{\cos x} + \frac{1}{\cos x} = \sqrt{3}\), \(\cos x \ne 0\), is liye \(\sin x + 1 = \sqrt{3}\cos x\)
\(\sin x = -1\) se \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), jahan \(\cos x = 0\): \(\tan x\), \(\sec x\) undefined, radd

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Squaring ne \(\sin x + 1 = -\sqrt{3}\cos x\) bhi hal kar di; \(\frac{5\pi}{6}\) usi ka root hai. Is liye har root ko asal equation mein rakhna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
5 Solve \(\cos x - \sin x = 1\). (5 marks)
(\(\cos x - \sin x = 1\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) alag karein, square karein, factorise karein aur har candidate asal equation mein check karein.

book_ref.quote: So every potential solution must be substituted back into the original equation before it is accepted.

blocks.prompt:
6 Solve \(\sin 2x + \sin x = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(\sin 2x + \sin x = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x\) laga kar factorise karein; \(\sin x\) cancel na karein.

book_ref.quote: never cancel a factor that contains \(x\)

steps: \(2\sin x\cos x + \sin x = 0\), yani \(\sin x(2\cos x + 1) = 0\)

blocks.prompt:
7 Solve \(\cos 2x + 3\cos x + 2 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(\cos 2x + 3\cos x + 2 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos 2x = 2\cos^{2}x - 1\) se \(\cos x\) mein quadratic banayein.

book_ref.quote: a product is zero only when one of its factors is zero

blocks.prompt:
8 Solve \(\sqrt{3}\sin^{2}x + (\sqrt{3} - 1)\sin x\cos x - \cos^{2}x = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(\sqrt{3}\sin^{2}x + (\sqrt{3} - 1)\sin x\cos x - \cos^{2}x = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Left side ko \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) ke do linear factors mein todein.

book_ref.quote: Reference angle from the positive value, quadrants from the sign

steps: \((\sqrt{3}\sin x - \cos x)(\sin x + \cos x)\) khol kar left side milta hai
Is liye \(\sqrt{3}\sin x = \cos x\) ya \(\sin x = -\cos x\)
Dono mein \(\cos x \ne 0\) (warna \(\sin x = 0\) bhi hota, jo na-mumkin hai), is liye \(\cos x\) se taqseem kar sakte hain
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{4}\); general solution \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\} \cup \left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.prompt:
9 Solve \(2\sin x\tan x - \tan x = 1 - 2\sin x\). (5 marks)
(\(2\sin x\tan x - \tan x = 1 - 2\sin x\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Tamam terms aik taraf la kar grouping se factorise karein.

book_ref.quote: Add the period: \(+2n\pi\) for \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\csc\), \(\sec\); \(+n\pi\) for \(\tan\), \(\cot\).

steps: Sine wale family ka period \(2\pi\), tangent wale ka \(\pi\)

blocks.prompt:
10 Solve \(\sin x + \sqrt{3}\cos x = 1\) by squaring, and reject the extraneous roots. (5 marks)
(\(\sin x + \sqrt{3}\cos x = 1\) ko square kar ke hal karein aur extraneous roots radd karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) alag karein, square kar ke \(\cos x\) mein quadratic banayein, phir chaaron candidates check karein.

blocks.prompt:
11 Solve \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) graphically in \([-\pi, \pi]\). Improve the positive root to two decimal places by the sign test. (5 marks)
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) ko \([-\pi, \pi]\) mein graph se hal karein. Positive root ko sign test se do decimal tak behtar karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = \sin x\) aur line \(y = \frac{x}{3}\) banayein, crossings ginein, phir symmetry aur sign test lagayein.

book_ref.quote: plotting the graphs of both sides of the equation and identifying their points of intersection

steps: Graphs: \(y = \sin x\) aur \(y = \frac{x}{3}\) (origin se guzarti line, slope \(\frac{1}{3}\))
Dono \((0, 0)\) se guzarte hain. \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par curve oopar, \(\pi\) par neeche: \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\) mein aik crossing
Dono functions odd hain, is liye \(\left(-\pi, -\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein bhi aik crossing: kul teen
Sign test: \(f(2.27) \approx 0.0087 > 0\), \(f(2.28) \approx -0.0011 < 0\), root \(2.27\) aur \(2.28\) ke darmiyan, \(2.28\) ke qareeb

blocks.prompt:
12 Solve \(\cos x = \frac{x}{4}\) graphically (no interval is given). (5 marks)
(\(\cos x = \frac{x}{4}\) ko graph se hal karein (koi interval nahin diya gaya).)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(\cos x\) ki range se dekhein ke solutions kahan ho sakte hain, phir table bana kar tarteeb ki tabdeeliyan ginein.

book_ref.quote: If no interval is given, use the range of the trigonometric side

steps: Check: \(\cos 1.25 \approx 0.315\), \(\frac{1.25}{4} \approx 0.313\); baqi do bhi isi tarah qareeb qareeb barabar

blocks.prompt:
13 Solve \(2\sin^{2}x = 3\cos x\) graphically in \([0, 2\pi]\), and confirm the roots exactly. (5 marks)
(\(2\sin^{2}x = 3\cos x\) ko \([0, 2\pi]\) mein graph se hal karein aur roots ki exact tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke multiples par table banayein, tarteeb ki tabdeeliyan ginein, phir \(\cos x\) mein quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: each change of order means one crossing

steps: \(y = 2\sin^{2}x\) \(0\) aur \(2\) ke darmiyan; \(y = 3\cos x\) \(-3\) aur \(3\) ke darmiyan

\(3\cos x\) \(0\) par oopar, \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(\pi\), \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par neeche, \(2\pi\) par phir oopar: \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) aur \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\right)\) mein aik aik crossing

blocks.prompt:
14 Solve \(\tan x = \frac{x}{3}\) graphically in \(\left[-\frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right]\). (5 marks)
(\(\tan x = \frac{x}{3}\) ko \(\left[-\frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right]\) mein graph se hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(\tan x\) ke asymptotes banayein, phir har branch ko line \(y = \frac{x}{3}\) ke muqable mein dekhein.

book_ref.quote: so its graph comes in separate branches.

steps: Darmiyani branch: dono \((0, 0)\) se; \(0 < x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\tan x > x > \frac{x}{3}\), is liye sirf \(x = 0\)
Daayen branch: \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\) par \(\tan x < 0 < \frac{x}{3}\): koi crossing nahin
\(\left(\pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)\) par \(\tan x\) \(0\) se \(+\infty\) tak barhta hai, line \(1.05\) aur \(1.57\) ke darmiyan: sirf aik crossing
Dono odd functions, is liye \(x \approx -4.08\) bhi root; check: \(\tan 4.078 \approx 1.359 \approx \frac{4.078}{3}\)

blocks.prompt:
15 Solve \(2\cos x = \sin x + 1\) graphically in \([0, 2\pi]\) and check each root by substitution. (5 marks)
(\(2\cos x = \sin x + 1\) ko \([0, 2\pi]\) mein graph se hal karein aur har root ko rakh kar check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = 2\cos x\) aur \(y = \sin x + 1\) ki \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke multiples par table banayein, tarteeb kahan badalti hai dekhein, crossings parhein aur check karein.

book_ref.quote: Graphical answers are approximate; check each one by substituting in both sides.

steps: \(y = 2\cos x\) \(-2\) aur \(2\) ke darmiyan; \(y = \sin x + 1\) \(0\) aur \(2\) ke darmiyan
\(0\) par \(2\cos x\) oopar, \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par neeche: \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein aik crossing, \(x \approx 0.64\)
\(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par dono \(0\), aur wahan tarteeb badalti hai: \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\) crossing hai

blocks.prompt:
16 A statue 6 m tall stands on a pedestal 24 m high. Find the angle that the statue subtends at a point on level ground 18 m from the foot of the pedestal. (5 marks)
(6 m ooncha mujassama 24 m oonche chabootre par khara hai. Chabootre ke qadam se 18 m door hamwar zameen par nuqte par mujassama kitna zaviya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mujasme ki choti aur us ke neeche tak ke zaviye \(\tan^{-1}\) se likhein aur difference formula se tafreeq karein.

book_ref.quote: The angle an object subtends (between the lines to its bottom and its top) is a difference of two such angles.

steps: Mujasme ke neeche (chabootre ki choti) tak: \(\theta_1 = \tan^{-1}\frac{24}{18} = \tan^{-1}\frac{4}{3}\)

blocks.prompt:
17 A flagpole 5 m long stands on top of a building. From a point on level ground 20 m from the foot of the building, the flagpole subtends the same angle as a 1 m stick standing at the foot of the building. Find (i) the exact height of the building (ii) the subtended angle. (5 marks)
(Imarat ki chhat par 5 m lamba jhanday ka danda hai. Imarat ke qadam se 20 m door hamwar zameen par nuqte se danda utna hi zaviya banata hai jitna imarat ke qadam par khari 1 m ki chhari. (i) Imarat ki exact oonchai (ii) yeh zaviya maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Danday ka zaviya do inverse tangents ka farq likhein, chhari ke zaviye ke barabar rakhein aur oonchai ke liye quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Since \(\tan^{-1}\) is one-one, the arguments are equal

steps: Oonchai \(h\). Danday ki choti tak \(\tan^{-1}\frac{h + 5}{20}\); neeche tak \(\tan^{-1}\frac{h}{20}\); chhari: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{20}\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Negative root \(\frac{-5 - 5\sqrt{257}}{2}\) bhi quadratic ko poora karta hai, magar oonchai manfi nahin ho sakti, is liye sirf positive root liya.

blocks.prompt:
18 A ball is kicked from the ground with \(v_0 = 25\) m/s. Using \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) with \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), (i) find the launch angles for which it lands 50 m away (ii) find the maximum range. (5 marks)
(Gaind zameen se \(v_0 = 25\) m/s se mari jati hai. \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) se (i) 50 m door girne ke launch angles (ii) maximum range maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 2\theta\) ko subject banayein, \((0^{\circ}, 180^{\circ})\) mein \(2\theta\) ki dono values nikalein, phir aadha karein.

book_ref.quote: gives two launch angles that add to \(90^{\circ}\)

steps: (ii) \(R_{\max} = \frac{625}{9.8} \approx 63.78\) m, \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\) par; \(50 < 63.78\), nishana pohanch mein hai

blocks.prompt:
19 From a point on level ground the angle of elevation of the top of a tower is \(30^{\circ}\). After walking 20 m towards the tower it becomes \(60^{\circ}\). Find the height of the tower and the final distance from its foot. (5 marks)
(Hamwar zameen par aik nuqte se minar ki choti ka angle of elevation \(30^{\circ}\) hai. Minar ki taraf 20 m chalne ke baad yeh \(60^{\circ}\) ho jata hai. Minar ki oonchai aur aakhri faasla maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har right triangle mein zaviye ka \(\tan\) likhein aur dono equations ikatthi hal karein.

book_ref.quote: In each right triangle write

blocks.prompt:
20 Using \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) with \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\): (i) find the least launch speed \(v_0\) that can send a ball 90 m (ii) with this speed, find the launch angles that give a range of 45 m. (5 marks)
(\(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) se: (i) gaind ko 90 m tak bhejne ke liye kam az kam speed \(v_0\) (ii) isi speed par 45 m range dene wale launch angles maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam az kam speed woh hai jis ki maximum range (\(45^{\circ}\) par) theek 90 m ho; phir \(\sin 2\theta = k\) hal karein.

book_ref.quote: The range is maximized when \(\sin 2\theta\) is maximized.

steps: \(\sin 2\theta \le 1\), is liye \(R \le \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\); kam az kam speed tab jab \(\frac{v_0^{2}}{g} = 90\) (\(45^{\circ}\) par)
